concept: ds4 streaming expert cache sizing under TP
summary: Because ownership skips the peer's experts before they are fetched, a rank's hot set is about half of what a single Mac sees; a cache count sized for single-Mac use wastes about half its slots on experts this rank will never request.

facts.text: Because ownership skips the peer's experts before they are fetched, a rank's hot set is about half of what a single Mac sees; a cache count sized for single-Mac use wastes about half its slots on experts this rank will never request.
`ds4_streaming_cacheable_expert_count` returns `layers * DS4_N_EXPERT` with no TP divisor
The "cacheable by this layer slice" cap keys on the pipeline `distributed.role` and layer range, not TP rank
A manual `--ssd-streaming-cache-experts` byte target is capped at 7/8 of the GPU recommended working-set size minus context and graph memory, rounded down to GiB with a 1 GiB floor
If the prefill headroom is at least the cache target, ds4 reduces the headroom to the target minus one expert and prints "prefill reserve reduced"
If no complete expert slot fits, ds4 prints "leaves no complete expert slot; using direct per-layer reads" and uses a cache budget of 0
Each TP rank sizes its cache from its own working-set size, and no budget is exchanged between ranks
Metal streaming fast paths such as the GLM tiny pair-SwiGLU path are gated on `tp_world < 2`
On ROCm the GLM streaming cache can grow by the prefill headroom after prefill unless `DS4_ROCM_GLM_STREAMING_GROW_CACHE_AFTER_PREFILL=0`
A cache count sized for single-Mac use wastes about half its slots under TP, since the peer's experts are skipped before fetch
